I'm planning out the file structure, covering the header, helper functions, and terrain base, then working through how the strata layers will be painted with rock-colored side gradients to look layered.

For the dunes I'm sketching ripple shading using sine waves and noise to create lit and shadowed sand bands on a flattened hemisphere geometry, then moving on to shaping the pond outline with a wavy radius function for its edge.

I'm now computing elliptical coordinates relative to the pond's center so I can determine depth bands (deep, shallow) and layer in ripple rings based on radial distance, blending water color shades accordingly.
